relationship: After publication 2018 paper source code and after date-only discovery; first prospective relative to new branch/time contrast, explicitly exploratory; original 2018 seasonal-solar results not reinterpreted as new finding

source.known_date_quality_warning: Year 2001 appears for 25 rows and must be retained as flagged in source audit, not imputed as another date. Exclude from 2013–2016 within-site branch comparison only.

method.sampling_units: physical site name × original calendar year; NO independent hardware operation data
method.rising_falling: < June 21 00:00 vs > June21 23:59 of each original calendar year, at least 7 days from solstice; keep original years 2013-2016; source 2001 anomalous flagged not silently corrected.
method.daylength_source: Original author sunrise and sunset HH:MM durations, BOTH supplied in source raw rows; no invented station coordinates. Correct same-date duration if consistent within 3 minutes, otherwise reject ambiguous site/date.
method.match: At each same site and calendar year, keep any photographed date if at least one photographed opposite-branch date has absolute author-source daylight length difference <=10min; assign eligibility based on dates across ALL published taxa after original source exclusions, never by focal taxon/time-zone count.
method.selection_warning: Date presence is detection-conditioned because missing camera deployments/uptime and absence days cannot be verified. This cannot establish unbiased season encounter-rate change or site probability of the branch effect.
method.phase_categories: Source author sunrise and sunset, daylight core middle half, daylight edge first and last 25% of sunshine, outside sunrise/sunset night; original clock time and source local sunrise/sunset assumed comparable; no independent timezone validation.
method.original_analysis_sample: Publication used 8761 independent detections after four exclusions; replicate this base count before computing branch observations. Source count per row denotes animals in image and does not validate independent individuals.
method.unit_independence: Rows treated only as descriptive recorded events, site-year as stratified group. Never test event-level independent-animal p.
method.all_taxa: Retain all original nonexcluded species field names with zero branch-zone counts, even undefined ratios.

endpoints: per source taxon core/edge/night photographed event counts by original site/year and branch
pooled falling-vs-rising edge/core and night/day record odds
site-year-stratified Mantel-Haenszel relative record odds and leave-one-site-out sensitivity
original-date candidate matching support including site-year and matched date counts
explicit missing hourly uptime, camera q, individual labels and new region held-out hold
no_claims: No new mammal seasonal movement law
No phylogenetic or independent-region replication based on one Northern Ireland study
No p-value from repeated photographed events or site-independent sampling
No new outdoor detection effort measured
Cannot use Ireland + Serengeti as a confirmatory universal law after exploratory source selection
stop_if: raw date or sunrise/sunset schema mismatch
